ar9av-obsidian-wiki-claude-history-inges.description: Ingest Claude Code conversation/session history into Obsidian as distilled knowledge. Use for importing or mining past Claude sessions, .claude data, project/session history, or audit logs.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-code-understand.description: Map the load-bearing files, symbols, callers, and dependencies of an unfamiliar codebase before making changes. Use for architecture orientation, impact analysis, what-would-break questions, or finding callers. Uses CodeGraph when available and a dependency-free builtin fallback.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-codex-history-ingest.description: Ingest Codex CLI conversation/session history into Obsidian as distilled knowledge. Use for importing or mining ~/.codex sessions, rollout files, indexes, or transcript logs; use wiki-agent for targeted topic-only recall.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-copilot-history-inge.description: Ingest GitHub Copilot CLI/session history into Obsidian as distilled knowledge. Use for importing or mining Copilot history; not for general Copilot help, simple session search, or backup.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-cross-linker.description: Find and add missing cross-references between wiki pages. Use when pages are disconnected or after large ingestion. This modifies pages to add links; use wiki-lint for report-oriented structural auditing.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-daily-update.description: Run or configure the daily wiki maintenance cycle: check source freshness, refresh the index and hot.md, and manage its scheduled 9 AM launchd/systemd/cron reminder. Use for daily or morning wiki refresh or scheduler setup and verification.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-graph-colorize.description: Configure Obsidian graph colors by tag, folder, category, or visibility by updating .obsidian/graph.json. Use for graph colorization; preserve other graph settings and back up before changes.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-hermes-history-inges.description: Ingest Hermes agent history into Obsidian as distilled knowledge. Use for importing or mining ~/.hermes sessions, memories, or logs; use wiki-agent for targeted topic-only cross-agent recall.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-impl-validator.description: Independently check whether an implementation matches its stated goal and return PASS/WARN/FAIL with actionable issues. Use for second-opinion validation of an implementation or generated output.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-llm-wiki.description: Explain and apply the foundational LLM Wiki architecture and knowledge-management strategy. Use for setup, architecture, schema, or organization decisions; operational ingest/query/lint work uses dedicated skills.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-memory-bridge.description: Browse or compare wiki knowledge by originating AI tool. Use for cross-tool memory questions, tool-specific knowledge, or gap/diff analysis between Codex, Claude, Hermes, and other agents.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-obsidian-layout-adju.description: Adjust the user's Obsidian visual layout with CSS snippets. Use for restyling tabs, sidebars, note surfaces, properties, backlinks, graph or file-explorer UI, or diagnosing CSS changes that did not take effect.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-openclaw-history-ing.description: Ingest OpenClaw session/history data into Obsidian as distilled knowledge. Use for importing or mining ~/.openclaw sessions, memory files, or logs; use wiki-agent for targeted topic-only cross-agent recall.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-pi-history-ingest.description: Ingest Pi coding-agent session history into Obsidian as distilled knowledge. Use for importing or mining ~/.pi/agent/sessions or Pi conversation logs; use wiki-agent for targeted topic-only recall.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-session-brain.description: Build or refresh a browser-viewable topic graph over Claude session history using local clustering. Use for mapping or clustering sessions, recent or stale topic analysis, or rebuilding/showing the session graph. Unlike wiki-history-ingest, it indexes raw sessions and never writes to the vault.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-session-search.description: Search the session-brain graph for a past agent session by topic and load the winning transcript into the current conversation. Use for finding which session handled X, when Y was last worked on, or whether this was done before. Read-only; requires a session-brain graph.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-tag-taxonomy.description: Apply and maintain the wiki's controlled tag vocabulary. Use for choosing, normalizing, auditing, or extending tags when creating or updating wiki pages; consult the taxonomy before assigning tags.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-vault-skill-factory.description: Create a reviewable Agent Skill package from mature curated wiki pages. Use when turning verified vault knowledge into a reusable skill. Reads the vault and writes only to a review directory; it does not install skills.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-agent.description: Search one AI agent's raw history for a specific topic, ingest only matching sessions, and return a synthesized answer. Use for targeted cross-agent recall; use wiki-history-ingest for bulk archival ingestion.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-capture.description: Turn the current conversation or finding into a structured permanent wiki note. Use for save/capture/preserve requests; QUICK MODE writes a fast _raw/ note. Supports named-vault routing such as @research save this. This captures current discussion, not external source ingestion.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-context-pack.description: Produce a token-bounded, citation-ready context slice from an existing Obsidian vault for a downstream agent or task. Use for "/wiki-context-pack", "use my vault as context", "context slice for X", "pack the wiki for my agent", or "bounded context for Y".

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-dashboard.description: Create dynamic, queryable Obsidian dashboard views using Bases or Dataview. Use for auto-updating tables, indexes, or structured views of vault content; not for ordinary question answering.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-dedup.description: Detect and merge wiki pages representing the same concept under different names. Use for page-identity deduplication and consolidation. Destructive merges require confirmation; not for link repair or general linting.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-digest.description: Produce a day/week/month knowledge digest summarizing what was learned, updated, and connected in the wiki. Use for readable recent-learning summaries; wiki-status reports source and ingestion state instead.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-export.description: Export the Obsidian wiki graph to JSON, GraphML, Neo4j Cypher, Postgres/SQL, HTML, or OKF bundles. Use when transferring or visualizing wiki data in external tools; wiki-import handles the reverse direction.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-history-ingest.description: Route generic agent-history ingestion requests to the appropriate specialized history-ingest skill. Use when the user asks to ingest AI-agent history without directly selecting the underlying agent-specific skill.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-import.description: Import a wiki graph into the current vault from graph.json or an OKF/markdown bundle. Use for transferring previously exported wiki content between vaults; pair with wiki-export for the reverse direction.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-ingest.description: Ingest new documents, raw text, folders, or URLs into the Obsidian wiki as distilled, linked knowledge. Use for general wiki ingestion when no more specific ingest skill applies, including processing _raw/ staged content.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-lint.description: Audit wiki health: broken links, orphans, contradictions, stale content, lifecycle and tag issues. Use for maintenance or health checks. Default is report-only; use wiki-dedup for page-identity merges.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-narrate.description: Turn a wiki topic into a cited Markdown briefing, plain-language explanation, or progressive lecture. Use this skill for topic-based briefing, explanation, and lecture requests that must stay within the evidence compiled in an Obsidian vault.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-query.description: Search and synthesize answers from the compiled Obsidian wiki, including cited and multi-hop answers. Use for questions about existing wiki knowledge or fast index-only lookups, and for challenge requests ("challenge this", "argue against X", "poke holes in my plan") that look for the vault's own evidence against a plan. Supports named-vault routing such as wiki-query @work; not for ingesting new sources.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-rebuild.description: Archive and rebuild wiki knowledge from source, or restore a prior archive. Use for full restart/recovery when incremental repair is inappropriate; this is broader and more destructive than ordinary update or lint.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-research.description: Perform multi-round web research on a topic, synthesize the findings, and file structured results into the Obsidian wiki. Use for comprehensive web-sourced research intended to become wiki knowledge.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-setup.description: Initialize or repair an Obsidian wiki vault's required structure and configuration. Use for new-vault setup, .env/config creation, reconfiguration, or broken setup recovery.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-stage-commit.description: Review staged wiki writes and promote accepted pages to final locations when WIKI_STAGED_WRITES is enabled. Use for staging approval/commit; rejected pages return to _raw/ for editing.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-status.description: Report wiki ingestion/completeness state, pending source delta, structural insights, or maintenance equilibrium. Use for remaining-work/status questions, hubs and bridges, or whether maintenance skills still have pending changes. wiki-digest summarizes learned knowledge instead.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-switch.description: List, create, or switch named Obsidian wiki vault profiles under the global config directory. Use when changing the active vault, checking which vault is active, or managing multi-vault profiles.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-synthesize.description: Find recurring concept combinations across the wiki that lack an explicit synthesis page, then create cross-cutting synthesis pages. Use for knowledge synthesis after the vault has accumulated enough material.

ar9av-obsidian-wiki-wiki-update.description: Sync knowledge from the current project into the Obsidian wiki. Use when work already in the current project should be distilled into the vault; named-vault routing includes @work update wiki. wiki-capture saves the current conversation and wiki-ingest handles external/new sources.
